name: russian twist (on stability ball arms straight)
description: A rotating move with your upper back on a stability ball and arms straight. It targets the obliques and core stability.
instructions: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball.
Lift your hips so your body is flat like a table.
Extend your arms straight above your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
